methodology.backend: Original source frozen before native-backend integration; FLUENTPY_BACKEND=python
methodology.sample_process: Fresh Python process per sample; Qt QApplication on native Windows QPA; hidden 960x640 window
methodology.timing: time.perf_counter; no instrumentation in timing samples; cProfile only separate final samples
methodology.render: setPlainText/setText + processEvents 3 times + QWidget.render; does not include process/import/widget startup
methodology.safety: Each child has 5 second hard timeout, including startup
methodology.dataset_recipe: scripts.benchmark_baseline.generate_json(lines), json.dumps ensure_ascii=False indent=2, exactly requested logical lines
methodology.line_edit_warning: QLineEdit is single-line, default maxLength=32767 UTF-16 units. line-full overrides maxLength; not a multiline JSON editor.
methodology.comparison_caution: plain-qt uses QPlainTextEdit default font; TextEdit uses UI sans font; CodeEdit uses Consolas/CJK fallback. Cross-widget results include different fonts/layout and should not be presented as Python-versus-C speedups. Compare original CodeEdit against updated CodeEdit for backend speedups.
